prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide 16:9 battle background for an original 2D Chinese animated-fantasy game. Paint Zhang E Mountain as an imposing mythological place, a bare mountain rich in exposed jade and stone, WITHOUT grass, trees or other vegetation. The world is majestic, slightly strange guofeng mythology; use a polished animated-film background language that belongs with expressive cel-shaded characters, not a photorealistic or cinematic concept-art texture study.

Composition: a wide eye-level view across a substantial fractured stone terrace occupying the lower third. The middle-left and middle-right of the terrace are unobstructed, mostly level areas for two opposing full-body combatants to be composited later. This is a playable side-view battle stage, not an aerial landscape or a narrow path. Large slab shapes, clear seams and a few chipped jade edges define the floor; avoid busy rubble, foreground pillars or deep fog hiding the characters' feet.

Midground and distance: a huge broken, uninscribed jade-and-charcoal ritual arch frames the mountain valley without blocking the terrace. Immense pale mineral-white and cool jade-green cliff shelves rise behind it. Simplified sweeping spires, angular jade outcrops, a deep chasm and one distant towering peak make the scale feel overwhelming. Thin pale cloud bands separate the depth layers. A restrained cinnabar-red glowing fracture in the distant stone recalls Bifang's fire omen; do not fill the stage with flames. Strange grandeur comes from the exaggerated mountain shapes and impossibly oversized arch, not modern joke objects.

Art direction: confident shaped contours, broad carefully designed color areas, sculptural rock silhouettes, controlled two- or three-step light and shadow groups, a few elegant brush accents and restrained atmospheric perspective. Neutral pale sky, mineral-white stone, charcoal foreground, cool jade-green accents and small cinnabar highlights; maintain color contrast instead of a monochrome blue or brown scene. Clear pearly daylight, readable bright battle floor, selected high-resolution details, no noisy photographic rock pores. Aim for a premium hand-painted guofeng animation background, neither flat childish clipart nor realistic fantasy matte painting.

Constraints: background environment only, no people, birds, monsters, weapons or other actors. No forests, bamboo, vegetation, modern structures, carved writing, floating decorative orbs, bokeh, heavy haze, motion blur, card frames, HUD, menus, text, labels, borders, logo or watermark. No split panels or collage. Do not copy any modern game or movie scene.
